info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of loyalty partners that enhance customer engagement and retention strategies. Through this endpoint, businesses can retrieve detailed information about various partners involved in loyalty programs, facilitating better decision-making for collaboration. This API is designed for marketing and customer relationship management teams looking to optimize loyalty initiatives. Typical use cases include integrating loyalty partner data into dashboards or applications that drive customer retention efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty program partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch a comprehensive list of available loyalty program partners, providing information such as partner names and details relevant to the loyalty offerings.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve a list of loyalty partners. This request expects a JSON object that may contain parameters used for filtering or pagination, allowing clients to specify how they want to receive and structure the response data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loyalty partners.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyPartnersRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation to retrieve loyalty partners. The body is expected as a string representation of a JSON object.
